testcase.name: Scenario: Click a folder highlighted by keyboard navigation: tmp/obk-folder-key-scenarios/features/application/document-creation/document-creation.feature:540:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Click a folder highlighted by keyboard navigation ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the template chooser shows the metric folder and its grouped templates ✔ And the details pane identifies the selected Standard (mm) part template ✔ When the user clicks Metric in the folder tree and presses Up ✔ Then English is highlighted in the tree ✔ And the metric gallery and Standard (mm) details remain visible ✔ When the user clicks the highlighted English folder ✔ Then the gallery displays the English folder templates ✔ And the details pane still identifies Standard (mm) with millimeter units ✔ When the user cancels the chooser ✔ Then the original part remains active
